---
title: "HPA Brain Data Analysis"
author: "Angela Duan"
---
Here I calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in human, pig, and mouse.

Human
```{r}
human_forebrain_elevated <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(human_forebrain_elevated)
```

Pig
```{r}
pig_forebrain_elevated <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(pig_forebrain_elevated)
```

Mouse
```{r}
mouse_forebrain_elevated <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(mouse_forebrain_elevated)
```

The highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain was 430, in humans.
